title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Arc Hybrid Compute Machines module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-arcmachine'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.
module_name: Azure Arc Hybrid Compute Machines module

agentUpgrade.type: object({ correlationId = optional(string, null) desiredVersion = optional(string, null) enableAutomaticUpgrade = optional(bool, false) })
agentUpgrade.description: (Optional) The info of the machine w.r.t Agent Upgrade: object({ correlationId = "(Optional) The correlation ID passed in from RSM per upgrade." desiredVersion = "(Optional) Specifies the version info w.r.t AgentUpgrade for the machine." enableAutomaticUpgrade = "(Optional) Specifies if RSM should try to upgrade this machine." })

arc_machine_extensions.type: map(object({ name = string publisher = string type = string automatic_upgrade_enabled = optional(bool, false) force_update_tag = optional(string, null) protected_settings = optional(string, null) settings = optional(string, null) type_handler_version = optional(string) }))
arc_machine_extensions.description: (Optional) A Hybrid Compute Machine Extension block as defined below map(object({ name = "(Required) The name which should be used for this Hybrid Compute Machine Extension. Changing this forces a new Hybrid Compute Machine Extension to be created." publisher = "(Required) The name of the extension handler publisher, such as `Microsoft.Azure.Monitor`. Changing this forces a new Hybrid Compute Machine Extension to be created." type = "(Required) Specifies the type of the extension. For example CustomScriptExtension or AzureMonitorLinuxAgent. Changing this forces a new Hybrid Compute Machine Extension to be created." automatic_upgrade_enabled = "(Optional) Indicates whether the extension should be automatically upgraded by the platform if there is a newer version available. Supported values are true and false. Defaults to true." force_update_tag = "(Optional) How the extension handler should be forced to update even if the extension configuration has not changed." protected_settings = "(Optional) The protected_settings passed to the extension, like settings, these are specified as a JSON object in a string." settings = "(Optional) The settings passed to the extension, these are specified as a JSON object in a string." type_handler_version = "(Optional) Specifies the version of the extension to use, available versions can be found using the Azure CLI." }))

arc_private_link_scope.type: object({ arc_private_link_scope_name = string public_network_access_enabled = optional(bool, false) })
arc_private_link_scope.description: (Optional) Azure Arc Private Link Scope configuration: object({ arc_private_link_scope_name = "(Required) The name which should be used for the Azure Arc Private Link Scope. Changing this forces a new Azure Arc Private Link Scope to be created." public_network_access_enabled = "(Optional) Indicates whether machines associated with the private link scope can also use public Azure Arc service endpoints. Possible values are `true` and `false`. Defaults to `false`." })

clientPublicKey.description: (Optional) Public Key that the client provides to be used during initial resource onboarding.

identity.description: (Optional) An identity block as defined below object({ type = "(Required) Type of managed service identity (where both SystemAssigned and UserAssigned types are allowed)." identity_ids = "(Optional) The set of user assigned identities associated with the resource." })

kind.description: (Optional) Indicates which kind of Arc machine placement on-premises, values accepted `AVS`, `AWS`, `EPS`, `GCP`, `HCI`, `SCVMM`, `VMware`.

licenseProfile.type: object({ esuProfile = optional(object({ licenseAssignmentState = optional(string, "NotAssigned") assignedLicense = optional(object({ geo-location = string properties = object({ licenseDetails = optional(object({ edition = optional(string, "Standard") processors = optional(number) state = optional(string, "Deactivated") target = optional(string, "Windows Server 2012") type = optional(string, "vCore") })) tenantId = optional(string, null) }) })) })) })
licenseProfile.description: (Optional) Specifies the License related properties for a machine: object({ esuProfile = (Optional) Properties for the Machine ESU profile: object({ licenseAssignmentState = "(Optional) Describes the license assignment state. Possible values are `Assigned` or `NotAssigned`." assignedLicense = The assigned license resource: object({ geo-location = "(Required) The geo-location where the resource lives." properties = (Required) Hybrid Compute License properties: object({ licenseDetails = Describes the properties of a License: object({ edition = "(Optional) Describes the edition of the license. The values are either `Standard` or `Datacenter`." processors = "(Optional) Describes the number of processors." state = "(Optional) Describes the state of the license. The values are either `Activated` or `Deactivated`." target = "(Optional) Describes the license target server. The values are either `Windows Server 2012 R2` or `Windows Server 2012`." type = "(Optional) Describes the license core type. The values are either `pCore` or `vCore`." }) licenseType = "(Optional) The type of the license resource. Accepts `ESU`." tenantId = "(Optional) Describes the tenant id." }) }) }) })

locationData.type: object({ city = optional(string) countryOrRegion = optional(string) district = optional(string) can_name = string })
locationData.description: (Optional) Metadata pertaining to the geographic location of the resource: object({ city = "(Optional) The city or locality where the resource is located." countryOrRegion = "(Optional) The country or region where the resource is located." district = "(Optional) The district, state, or province where the resource is located." can_name = "(Required) A canonical name for the geographic or physical location. `Max length = 256`." })

mssqlDiscovered.description: (Optional) Specifies whether any MS SQL instance is discovered on the machine.
